## Result

- Skill: delivery-review
- Review status: approved
- Review ID: delivery-review-r3.
- Primary package: the single exact unchanged registered plan subject.
- Current upstream Design: design-review-r6 and its exact four subjects.
- Findings: none; no plan correction, work initialization or routing performed.
- Claim limits: planning/proof applicability only, not M2 implementation, whole-change Code Review, Verify or publication.

## Bounded reassessment

The complete sequencing and proof judgment from delivery-review-r2 remains adequate. Independent SHA-256 and subject inspection confirm the plan is byte-identical to its approved r2 subject. Design r6 independently approves the current four-member package: all DES-SR rows and scoped installer obligations/outcomes remain unchanged, System/Workflow remain byte-identical, and the two Design transition descriptions plus historical installer approval presentation alter neither work order nor protection. Supporting owner notices and mapped source dispositions implement the already allocated M2 responsibility. No requirement, boundary, interaction, acceptance condition or command allocation was added or removed.

M1 remains private safety support before M2 connects the coherent public method/consumers/installer/package/authority transition. TG-01–07 and TG-FINAL-01/02 retain local and integrated proof, three MW procedures, actual public-path recovery/concurrency checks, conditional release-only V9, fresh final whole-change independent Code Review and distinct Verify. Those checkpoints remain required; this assessment does not equate the manual walkthroughs or passing source checks with milestone completion.

The plan's source-artifact link to r5 retains its original authoring-time basis and explicit prohibition on retargeting it. This fresh reviewer-owned judgment affirmatively binds the unchanged allocation to r6's current subjects; it does not amend, relabel or retarget r5 or Delivery r2. No replan is justified by presentation/reference-only changes. Current lifecycle reliance must use this renewed assessment, not infer that r2 assessed revised Design identities.

## Additional adoption-source assessment

The exact workflow-skill-artifact-location-map.md diff adds only Unified authoring compatibility. The earlier historical/supersession notice and complete old contract remain unchanged. Legacy owner labels and artifact-location keys are correctly retained as compatibility metadata, not resurrected public authors. Current governed model identity comes from primary context/subject inspection; the unified author applies an unmigrated source's declared contract. This is the demonstrated actor-reference clarification explicitly allocated to M2, not a new discovery kind/schema, routing behavior, customer adoption or substantive legacy feature amendment. It adds no new requirement to the approved Design inventory. This supplementary assessment extends the supporting adoption basis without changing r6's four core subjects or original review body.

## Failed evidence and limits

The two historical architecture-method boundary-marker failures and thirteen original installer prose errors remain failed baseline evidence. The unchanged plan already requires exact retained-baseline comparison and responsible applicability judgment; this renewal grants no blanket waiver and does not call those commands passed. Final Verify must judge the touched authoritative scope and actual failed evidence. Implementation and package tests still require independent Code Review. Earlier review history and all finding origins are preserved.

## Independence

Independent nonauthor reviewer /root/independent_design_review retained the prior complete Delivery assessment and independently compared current Design/adoption changes and exact unchanged plan. Primary-agent authored the engineering/plan contributions; reviewer authored only assessments/evidence.
